## Checklist

- [ ] The diff contains one logical change and no unrelated churn.
- [ ] Tests were added first for changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private runtime state, or generated junk is included.
- [ ] QA/AppSec evidence is provided when required by role authority.
